description: Configurable multi-factor risk assessment engine fusing Module A, Module B, and Safety Slope analysis.

risk_levels.NORMAL: Component exhibits nominal thermal degradation within safe peer envelope. Approved for production.
risk_levels.WATCH: Component shows moderate drift or minor peer outlier tendency. Recommended for extended screening / secondary audit.
risk_levels.HIGH_RISK: Component exhibits hazardous kinetic drift or anomalous trajectory. High probability of latent defect escape. Immediate quarantine / reject.
